title: The Trail of Patagonia's dry side
author: Wendell Yarrow
blurb: Ansel Coldharbour, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
